blocks.text: SHARIFF AGUAK, Maguindanao del Sur – For the second time, warring factions of the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF) in Maguindanao del Sur have agreed to bury the hatchet and avoid using force to settle their misunderstanding. Abu Salwa of MILF 105th Base Command and Samad Simpal of MILF 118th Base Command signed a peace deal at the office of Mayor Akmad Ampatuan in Shariff Aguak town. Ampatuan and Col. John Michael Mangahis, Maguindanao del Sur police director, brokered the ceasefire.
